use_case_summary: Aurora wants a JetBrains IDE plugin that performs code completions and whole-line suggestions with a local indexed cache of their mono-repos. When local model/cache cannot satisfy a request or for longer transforms, plugin streams from Redwood hosted models with a deterministic fallback chain. Needs model-version pinning for reproducible CI results and A/B rollout support for plugin releases.
integration_preferences: Prefer WebSocket streaming for token-level low-latency; SSE fallback acceptable. Plugin will run a light local indexer; heavier inference should be routed to private agent (on-prem) when customer subscribes. Require SDK support for IntelliJ actions and token-level interruption/cancellation.
poc_success_criteria: 1) median token latency <100ms on local cache hits across 95% of dev machines; 2) end-to-end completion time for 1-3 line suggestions <250ms when routing to private agent; 3) reproducible outputs when model pinned; 4) documentation and sample SSO config for enterprise install.
